correctionNotes: Treble around 5–6 kHz can edge into harshness on bright recordings; a small cut smooths it.
Sub-bass extends well but is slightly light in quantity; a gentle low shelf adds body.
Mids are accurate, so avoid large mid-range moves.
signature: Planar-clean and neutral-bright; fast tight bass, transparent mids, and an energetic treble with a mild peak around 5–6 kHz.
